text: The Patriots are dealing with significant offensive line disruption heading into their Week 3 matchup against Jacksonville, as starting right guard Mike Onwenu's broken right ankle has landed him on injured reserve, prompting the team to sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the 53-man roster and add tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. While the specifics of Drake Maye's performance against Pittsburgh remain under film review, what's clear is that the Patriots' defense carried the load in last week's 20-3 win over the Steelers—dominating in man coverage while TreVeyon Henderson powered the ground game with a touchdown—even as the offense continues searching for the rhythmic efficiency that fueled their Super Bowl campaign. The Patriots and Jacksonville will square off at Everbank Stadium on Sunday at 1 PM ET, with New England looking to build on the defensive excellence that masked their offensive struggles thus far, while the roster adjustments suggest the team is scrambling to shore up an increasingly vulnerable line in front of their young quarterback.
